DHPI.Title: PDF Importer
DHPI.MenuHint: Import adversaries, environments, weapons, armor and journal text from a Daggerheart PDF.

Select.title: Import content from a PDF
Select.hint: Drop a PDF here, choose one from your computer, or pick one from the Foundry data folder.
Select.supported: Recognises adversary and environment stat blocks, weapon and armor tables, and the running text (as a journal). The PDF itself can also be added to the journal. Scanned or image-only PDFs contain no text, so only the PDF itself can be imported.

Warning.noText: This PDF contains no extractable text. It is probably scanned or made of images: recognise its text with OCR below, or import it as a PDF journal.
Warning.nothingFound: No importable content was recognised in this PDF.

Error.upload: The server did not return a path for the uploaded file.
Error.uploadFailed: Could not upload the PDF for the journal: {message}

Attribution.title: Attribution
Attribution.pageOffsetHint: Added to the PDF page number to get the printed page number used in attributions.

DHPI.Name: Name
DHPI.JournalPdfOnly: The PDF as a journal page

Result.partial: Imported {created} documents, {failed} failed: {names}. The failed entries are still selected so you can retry.

Links.unmatched: No adversary with this name was found; it stays as text

pdfFolder.name: PDF upload folder
pdfFolder.hint: Folder in the Foundry data directory where PDFs chosen from your computer are uploaded when a journal includes the PDF. PDFs picked from the Foundry files are used where they are.

OCR.offerAllTitle: This PDF has no text layer, it contains only images (for example a scan).
OCR.offerHint: Text on these pages can be recognised with OCR. The OCR engine (about 15 MB) is downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net the first time and cached by your browser. Recognition takes a few seconds per page.
OCR.noPages: None of the entered pages are image-only pages.
OCR.done: Recognised text on {pages} pages; {found} entries found there.
OCR.usedTitle: Some contents were detected via OCR
OCR.usedAllTitle: The contents were detected via OCR
OCR.usedHint: Text on pages {pages} was recognised from images, which is not as accurate as reading text from the PDF. Entries marked OCR may contain misread words or numbers: check names, stats and dice before importing.
OCR.badge: Detected via OCR: check for misread words or numbers

Glyphs.offerTitle: {count} characters have no text in this PDF (shown as [?])
Glyphs.offerHint: The PDF draws them (often numbers such as dice), but its fonts don't say which characters they are, so they can't be copied or read. They can be recovered by recognising a few lines of the rendered page with OCR; the result is applied to every place the same character appears. The OCR engine (about 15 MB) is downloaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net the first time.
Glyphs.partial: Recovered {resolved} missing characters; {remaining} places could not be recovered and still show [?].
Glyphs.recoveredTitle: {count} missing characters were recovered via OCR
Glyphs.recoveredHint: These characters were read from the rendered page because the PDF has no text for them. This is reliable for clear text, but check numbers and dice in the affected features.
